brief_summary: Composite of product packshot onto a lifestyle scene. Lighting must match between layers; commerce vertical, premium mood.

rationale.consistency: Product layer is lit from the left while the scene is lit from the right; clear lighting mismatch.
rationale.aesthetic_balance: Composition is slightly off-center but not catastrophically so.
rationale.brief_match: Premium mood is partially achieved but undermined by the visible compositing seam around the product.

notable_issues: Hard cutout edge visible on product silhouette
Cast shadow on product does not match scene light direction
